tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind everything; the sky the map floats on. Fallbacks: 256 dark 233 / light 255; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Pane bodies, conversation and map canvas. Fallbacks: 256 dark 234 / light 231; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Tree sidebar, global status bar, pane status lines, prompt box. Fallbacks: 256 dark 235 / light 254; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Session nodes, question and permission cards, menus, dialogs. Light theme sets it apart with line-strong, not shade. Fallbacks: 256 dark 236 / light 231; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Web pointer hover on rows and chips. The TUI has no hover state. Fallbacks: 256 dark 235 / light 255; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the tree cursor, chosen options, multi-select picks. 16-color: reverse video. Fallbacks: 256 dark 237 / light 195; 16 colors default reverse.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and conversation, on bg, surface, panel, raised and selection. Fallbacks: 256 dark 254 / light 234; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: fg-strong
tokens.usage: Session names, the focused pane title, chosen values; always bold. On every surface. Fallbacks: 256 dark 231 / light 232; 16 colors default bold.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (project, branch, times, counts), tool output, secondary labels; the TUI's dim. On every surface. Fallbacks: 256 dark 248 / light 60; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, tree guides, placeholder text. Never for information you need: 3:1 only. Fallbacks: 256 dark 244 / light 244; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Unfocused pane borders and hairline dividers. Decorative; position already says where a pane ends. Fallbacks: 256 dark 235 / light 254; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Card and node outlines in the light theme, menu borders, context-bar track. Fallbacks: 256 dark 237 / light 252; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: prompt box, inputs, option boxes. 3:1 on every surface. Fallbacks: 256 dark 244 / light 244; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focused pane border (TUI heavy line, web 2px), focus ring, tree cursor bar. 16-color: heavy border + bold title. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 61; 16 colors default bold.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The wordmark and the prefix indicator. Never decoration. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 26; 16 colors blue.

tokens.name: fill-brand
tokens.usage: Prefix-active indicator and the primary action in a dialog. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 61; 16 colors blue bold.

tokens.name: on-fill-brand
tokens.usage: Text on fill-brand. Fallbacks: 256 dark 232 / light 231; 16 colors bright_white bold.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: ● working: the glyph, the word, the activity spinner. On every surface. Fallbacks: 256 dark 39 / light 25; 16 colors blue.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Text form of ? needs you, for flags inside a line. Prefer the fill. Fallbacks: 256 dark 214 / light 94; 16 colors yellow bold.

tokens.name: status-waiting-fill
tokens.usage: The ? needs you chip. The only amber fill in the product: if it is amber and filled, a session is waiting for you. Fallbacks: 256 dark 214 / light 214; 16 colors yellow bold.

tokens.name: on-status-waiting-fill
tokens.usage: Text on status-waiting-fill. Fallbacks: 256 dark 233 / light 233; 16 colors black bold.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: ○ idle: finished its turn, nothing pending. Fallbacks: 256 dark 248 / light 60; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: status-stale
tokens.usage: ◌ stale: idle past the forgotten threshold (default 30 min). Glyph, word and age in rose. Fallbacks: 256 dark 212 / light 125; 16 colors magenta.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: × error: the turn or the process failed. Fallbacks: 256 dark 209 / light 124; 16 colors red bold.

tokens.name: status-stopped
tokens.usage: ■ stopped: exiting or exited; shown in the launcher and resume picker, then leaves the map. Fallbacks: 256 dark 248 / light 60; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: mode-default
tokens.usage: · default (Claude Code's manual): asks before edits and commands. Fallbacks: 256 dark 248 / light 60; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: mode-plan
tokens.usage: ‖ plan: reads only until you approve a plan. Fallbacks: 256 dark 42 / light 22; 16 colors green.

tokens.name: mode-edits
tokens.usage: ± accept edits: file edits go through without asking. Fallbacks: 256 dark 177 / light 92; 16 colors magenta.

tokens.name: mode-auto
tokens.usage: » auto: a classifier approves most actions. Filled chip: runs commands without you. Fallbacks: 256 dark 141 / light 92; 16 colors magenta bold.

tokens.name: on-mode-auto
tokens.usage: Text on mode-auto. Fallbacks: 256 dark 232 / light 231; 16 colors bright_white bold.

tokens.name: mode-bypass
tokens.usage: ! bypass permissions: nothing is checked. Filled vermillion chip plus the hazard edge on the pane and node. Fallbacks: 256 dark 209 / light 160; 16 colors red bold.

tokens.name: on-mode-bypass
tokens.usage: Text on mode-bypass. Fallbacks: 256 dark 232 / light 231; 16 colors bright_white bold.

tokens.name: mode-dontask
tokens.usage: ∅ don't ask: never waits; anything that would ask is denied. Shown with a denied count. Fallbacks: 256 dark 110 / light 241; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: msg-prompt
tokens.usage: › your prompt (one per turn). Starlight is your voice. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 26; 16 colors default bold.

tokens.name: msg-slash
tokens.usage: / slash command you ran. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 26; 16 colors default bold.

tokens.name: msg-tool
tokens.usage: λ tool call (Bash, Edit, Read, Agent …): the glyph and tool name; arguments stay fg-muted. Fallbacks: 256 dark 39 / light 25; 16 colors blue.

tokens.name: msg-question
tokens.usage: ? question or permission asked. Bold while unanswered. Fallbacks: 256 dark 214 / light 94; 16 colors yellow.

tokens.name: msg-answer
tokens.usage: ✓ question answered, permission allowed. Fallbacks: 256 dark 42 / light 22; 16 colors green.

tokens.name: msg-denied
tokens.usage: × permission denied, tool failed. Fallbacks: 256 dark 209 / light 124; 16 colors red.

tokens.name: msg-sent
tokens.usage: → message sent to another session. Fallbacks: 256 dark 80 / light 23; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: msg-received
tokens.usage: ← message received from another session (also every message to an external session from you). Fallbacks: 256 dark 80 / light 23; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: msg-subagent
tokens.usage: ◦ subagent started, ↑ subagent reported back. Fallbacks: 256 dark 80 / light 23; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: msg-reply
tokens.usage: ¶ the agent's reply text. Fallbacks: 256 dark 254 / light 234; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: res-normal
tokens.usage: Sparkline bars and context fill below the warning threshold. Fallbacks: 256 dark 104 / light 61; 16 colors default.

tokens.name: res-warning
tokens.usage: △ warning: context ≥ 80 %, CPU busy > 5 min, memory/GPU ≥ 80 % of its limit. Text and bars, never a fill. Fallbacks: 256 dark 214 / light 94; 16 colors yellow.

tokens.name: res-critical
tokens.usage: ▲ critical: context ≥ 95 %, a limit passed. Bars and text. Fallbacks: 256 dark 209 / light 124; 16 colors red bold.

tokens.name: res-critical-fill
tokens.usage: The ▲ chip in the status bar and on nodes when a limit is passed. Fallbacks: 256 dark 209 / light 160; 16 colors red bold.

tokens.name: on-res-critical-fill
tokens.usage: Text on res-critical-fill. Fallbacks: 256 dark 232 / light 231; 16 colors bright_white bold.

tokens.name: res-track
tokens.usage: Empty part of the context bar and sparkline baseline. Fallbacks: 256 dark 237 / light 252; 16 colors default dim.

tokens.name: kind-managed
tokens.usage: ◆ managed (started here, full control): the glyph; node and pane borders stay solid. Fallbacks: 256 dark 147 / light 61; 16 colors default bold.

tokens.name: kind-external
tokens.usage: ◇ external (started elsewhere, watched): the glyph, the ext tag and the dashed border. Fallbacks: 256 dark 110 / light 60; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Message edges on the map and link lanes in the TUI; weight shows volume. Fallbacks: 256 dark 80 / light 23; 16 colors cyan.

tokens.name: edge-subagent
tokens.usage: Parent to subagent links (dotted). Fallbacks: 256 dark 103 / light 60; 16 colors default dim.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "Symbols Nerd Font Mono", monospace

groups.name: Cell styles
groups.note: One family, one size. Hierarchy comes from the five attributes the terminal also has: bold, dim, italic, underline, reverse.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Everything by default: conversation, rows, nodes. TUI: plain.

styles.name: text-bold
styles.usage: Session names, focused titles, chosen values, keys in hints. TUI: bold.

styles.name: text-dim
styles.usage: Metadata, tool output, timestamps; pair with fg-muted. TUI: dim.

styles.name: text-italic
styles.sample: Summary: refactoring token refresh, 3 of 5 files done
styles.usage: Model-written text (summaries) and placeholders. TUI: italic, never the only signal.

styles.name: text-link
styles.usage: Jumpable references (files, sessions, message ids); add text-decoration underline. TUI: underline.

groups.name: Web density
groups.note: Web-only sizes for chrome that is one line tall in the TUI.

styles.name: text-chrome
styles.usage: Status bar, status lines, chips, key hints.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (TUI: bold dim uppercase).

spacing.note: Web lengths are cell multiples: 1 cell = 8px (≈1ch of the 13px mono face), 1 line = 20px. The TUI uses the same counts in cells and lines.

tokens.name: cell-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, pane and row inner padding (TUI: 1 cell, padding 0 1). TUI: 1.

tokens.name: cell-2
tokens.usage: One tree indent level; gap between chips in the status bar. TUI: 2.

tokens.name: cell-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on the web (TUI: 1 cell plus the border). TUI: 3.

tokens.name: cell-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between project clusters on the map. TUI: 4.

tokens.name: row-half
tokens.usage: Web-only vertical breathing inside cards. No TUI equivalent, so never between rows. TUI: –.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: Row height: tree rows, menu items, status bar, status line, conversation line height. TUI: 1 line.

tokens.name: row-2
tokens.usage: A compact session node; one map lane. TUI: 2 lines.

radius.note: Square means tiled, rounded means floating. TUI: square = solid/heavy/dashed borders, rounded = round (╭╮).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panes, sidebars, status bar, status lines: everything tiled.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status, mode and key chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Session nodes, question and permission cards, menus, dialogs (TUI round border).

shadow.note: Only floating things cast shadows, and only on the web. The TUI uses a round border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Command menu, pickers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on web controls: a 1px ground gap, then 2px starlight.

stroke.note: Line weights. TUI maps them to box-drawing weights: light ─, heavy ━, double ═.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Every border at rest (TUI light line).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focused pane, focused node, focus ring (TUI heavy line).

tokens.name: edge-1
tokens.usage: Message edge with 1–2 messages (TUI ─).

tokens.name: edge-2
tokens.usage: Message edge with 3–9 messages (TUI ━).

tokens.name: edge-3
tokens.usage: Message edge with 10+ messages (TUI ═).
